design_philosophy: Mewah dan elegan (Luxurious and elegant). Premium editorial feel akin to high-end media conglomerates. Strict adherence to WCAG 8:1 contrast ratios. Fully responsive without relying on build tools.

typography.guidelines: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for headings. H1 max 4rem (fluid scaling), avoid oversized text. Body text must remain readable and legible at 16px minimum base size.
typography.pairing_archetype: The 'Old Money Tech' - Classic Serif Headings + Sterile Clean Body.

colors.philosophy: Strict WCAG contrast ratio >= 8:1 for all text and background pairings. Avoid 'vibrating' colors. Use deep, rich tones for the luxury feel.

dashboard_100_palette_system.logic: Use CSS variables to drive themes. Group palettes by Lightness and Base Tone. Apply relative luminance JS calculation to determine accessible button text color.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Optical Clarity' for sticky headers (solid background with slight transparency and strong blur, plus a 1px border for separation). DO NOT use fully transparent backgrounds behind text.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders using low-opacity contrasting colors (e.g., rgba(0,0,0,0.1) on light, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) on dark) to establish grid boundaries elegantly.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft, diffuse ambient shadows for cards. Never harsh. e.g., box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);

mega_menu.desktop: Hover-activated, full-width dropdown tray below the header. Must include generous padding (e.g., 2rem or 32px), logical grouping of the 6 outlets, and a solid background (no transparent glass) to ensure >8:1 contrast.
mega_menu.mobile: Hamburger icon toggling a full-screen or slide-out off-canvas menu. Accordion style for the mega-menu items.

hero_carousel.style: Modern, elegant slide transition (fade or smooth slide). Auto-play with pause-on-hover.
hero_carousel.overlays: CRITICAL: Image overlays must be dark enough (e.g., rgba(0,0,0,0.6)) or use a strong gradient to ensure the overlaying white text passes the 8:1 contrast ratio.
hero_carousel.controls: Minimalist arrows or thin progress bars/dots for navigation.

outlet_showcase_grid.cards: Each card must have a white chip/circle for the logo, the outlet name in Serif font, and the tagline in italic or subtle sans-serif. Apply subtle lift on hover (transform: translateY(-4px)).

dashboard_sidebar.mobile_behavior: Off-canvas slide-out menu with a dark overlay on the main content. Toggled via a floating hamburger button or top-bar menu icon.
dashboard_sidebar.desktop_behavior: Fixed left sidebar, elegant separation via 1px right border.

grids.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy. Use 2x standard padding (e.g., section padding 80px to 120px on desktop) to give elements 'breathing room' characteristic of luxury brands.

layouts.responsiveness: Mobile-first approach using standard CSS media queries (@media (min-width: 768px), etc.). Ensure no horizontal scrolling by setting max-width: 100% and box-sizing: border-box.

motion.interactions: Smooth transitions on all interactive elements (transition: all 0.3s ease - wait, transition specific properties: background-color 0.3s, transform 0.3s, color 0.3s). Avoid 'transition: all' to prevent transform bugs.

accessibility.dynamic_button_text_color_logic: Provide a JS function in the main script to calculate relative luminance of the selected theme color. Formula: L = (0.2126*R + 0.7152*G + 0.0722*B). If L > 128 (or ~0.5 in 0-1 scale), set text to #000000; else set to #FFFFFF. This ensures button text is always readable against dynamic background colors.
accessibility.aria_labels: All interactive elements, especially the mega menu and carousel controls, must have appropriate aria-labels and roles.

hero_carousel_1.description: Aerial photograph of high rise building during golden hour (For corporate holding hero)

hero_carousel_2.description: Woman using gold iPad (For digital news representation)

hero_carousel_3.description: Bundle of newspaper on table (For print heritage representation)

instructions_to_main_agent.stack_constraints: CRITICAL: The user EXPLICITLY requested plain PHP + HTML + CSS + Vanilla JS. DO NOT USE React. DO NOT USE Tailwind. DO NOT use a build step. Use semantic HTML5, pure CSS3 (with CSS variables for theming), and vanilla JavaScript (ES6).
instructions_to_main_agent.theme_implementation: Implement the 100+ color logic using CSS variables (e.g., :root { --bg-main: #...; --text-main: #...; }). Create a small Vanilla JS script for the dashboard that updates these variables on the document.documentElement based on the user's color selection.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="mega-menu-trigger"`).
instructions_to_main_agent.file_structure: Structure the CSS cleanly (e.g., style.css) and JS cleanly (e.g., script.js). PHP files should include these assets cleanly without requiring a bundler.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not make generic centered layouts. Use elegant left-aligned or asymmetric grid layouts.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💡).
Ensure the mega-menu is fully functional on mobile via an off-canvas drawer (built with vanilla JS and CSS transforms, no libraries).
Use Phosphor Icons (via CDN) or inline SVGs for high-end iconography.
Include hover states, transitions, and focus states on all interactive elements using explicit CSS transition properties.
